# Does your GITHUB_TOKEN use least-privilege permissions?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every workflow or job with no explicit permissions block (running on the ambient default) or permissions: write-all. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
